name: plan-overview-targets-unverified-undeduplicated
body: The plan-overview targets column is per-task and not deduplicated (a large phase can produce a long line), and no automated test executes the overview query — task-20's registeredTool assertion only inspects registration, so the runtime path is first exercised against a current DB; the branch db.lbug is stale (no Agent table and Task still carries verb/target), so it cannot run here. Limit: the column is unverified at runtime and un-deduplicated. Upgrade: add per-phase dedup or truncation if readability suffers, and add a runtime test when the branch DB carries the task-edge tables.
